reviews.x: This was fun. I'm pretty good with eyeliner but this really makes it quick easy and convenient. And it lasted 10+ hours. I bartend and my makeup always runs or comes off by the end of the night but this made it through the storm! I feel it's reasonably priced as well, I will always make sure I have this in my make up bag(s). Don't be discouraged if it feels awkward while using or you can't get them to match. No one notices but you, it becomes more comfortable and second nature after the 3rd use!

Overall, this works okay. I cannot do winged eyeliner for the life of me, so this pen was very appealing. I liked that it had eyeliner on the other end, so the two colors/sheens of the eyeliner and stamp are uniform. I did have to try the stamp a few times, as my eyes are big and every now and then, the stamp did not get my whole eye (so there were spaces it did not get to). I'd recommend stamping it with your eye closed. You also have to practice so both sides are at the right angle. I thought

I just got this in the mail today and was so excited to try it since I was in a rush. The eyeliner STAMP is very light in my opinion. I was able to use it as an outline and go over with my regular liquid liner though and made it work. The regular side has a wonderful find tip but it gets wide so fast it's like using a giant marker! It got the job done fast though which I really liked. It will take some practice to get perfectly matching wings, so be cautious!

This is amazing. I was so skeptical about trying it.  It was so easy to use, I did this in 5 seconds. The felt pen on the other side is awesome as well. It's not too soft, but not too hard either. I am recommending this to everyone.

reviews.t: Sold eyeliner with a great stamp!
reviews.x: I would say that is pen is half-half for me. On one hand, the stamp end is pretty amazing. I thought it was pretty at first, but it actually makes a great guideline so that my eyeliner is actually symmetrical. On the other had, I don't like the pointed tip. There's nothing wrong with it - I just happen to like liner with an extremely flexible tip. This liner is definitely felt tip and not brush tip, as I am more comfortable with. The liner itself is a nice dark black, and lasts well but isn't an

This is the BEST eyeliner I've found in years. I'm 22 and have been using eyeliner since I was 15. The eyeliner is matte, you can go over the line you drew without it cracking or flaking off, it lasts all day and the eyeliner isn't thick even if you draw over the lines you already have. I almost never use the stamp part just because I like my eyeliner a different shape, but the pen is amazing. Great buy and I won't purchase anything but this pen.

This really takes the guesswork out of being able to sport flawless cat-eye liner! I love it, and highly recommend this awesome product to anyone who wants to look pro without spending an hour on eyeliner!
Easy to apply and the fine tip point is awesome. Only problem is if you sweat at all due to a humid day, it comes off. Only Lasts a few hours.

I was looking for a smudge-proof pen when I ordered this. Still can’t get the wing down which is no big deal but I really like the pen’s thickness. However, it is not smudge-proof so I won’t re-order.

reviews.t: Very good product. It takes a bit of learning to ...
reviews.x: Very good product. It takes a bit of learning to get the stamp placement just right, but once you know it, it applies easily and stays applied.

reviews.t: If you want perfect wings -  buy this eyeliner
reviews.x: This works just as good if not better than the name brand "stampers" my cat eyes are perfect now. I will definitely be re-purchasing.
It's a decent product, I wish it had a smaller wing stamp, I like my eyeliner to look like Nicki Minaj's but practice makes perfect

reviews.t: great idea but only buy it if you want to look like a raccoon.
reviews.x: The product smudged about 30 minutes after i applied it causing me to look like a raccoon all day.

Makes doing a cat eye super easy, for a non adept hand like mine... I’ve always loved the look, but never been able to successfully do it until I purchased this pen! It glides on quite easily, and doesn’t smudge up even after a 13 hour workday. Also it stays mostly put through tears at sappy tv commercials or reunions with best friend that have moved far away! I sometimes use just the thin tip liner, too; It lasts the longest out of my multiple, pricier (albeit drugstore) black eyeliners. I will

I couldn't do a wing look to save my life. I was always skeptical about this stamp, stencils and etc until I gave this one a try. Received it yesterday and instantly tried it, and I love it!! It might not stamp a perfect wing, but its enough to get that perfect wing look. You stamp, you fill it in a little with the eyeliner tip and it's the perfect winged eyeliner look! Definitely recommend it!

Coming from someone who never wears makeup and couldn't figure out winged eyeliner to save my life, this is awesome! It took a few tries to get them angled the same but not hard to use at all. I'm one of those people that use reviews to judge if a product is worth buying, and seriously, if you are not "makeup inclined", GET THIS! It is worth the buy!

I do not have the eyes for wings. I have very hooded eyes and while the little wedge shaped stamp works, the creases change the wing shape, which is not the products fault.  On the other hand, the other side has a great eyeliner pen that lasts all day and doesn’t smudge. So not a complete waste. I say try it if you have trouble drawing on your own wings.

This product is great - creates even wings on both sides very easily. However, you still have to be careful lining up the wings properly - just because the are equal in shape doesn't mean they are pointing the same direction!  I notice that it applies a bit light, but I just apply a coat of my regular eyeliner over it and it lasts all day.

reviews.t: Nice product, not sure how my eyeliner tube came slashed
reviews.x: I'm giving this 3 stars because of the packaging. One of my tops came slashed and melted somehow?  The stamp was great. I will go crazy with my winged eyeliner sometimes so it was nice to have a guideline! I enjoyed using the eyeliner overall. I had to be go over the eyeliner a free times to achieve the darkness I wanted.

I’ve recently had a brain injury and a stroke so I can’t close one eye all the way and I don’t have the finesse right now with make up like l used to and this is awesome!! My make up looks pretty good!! Love the stamp it’s easy to use aand easy to take off!

I was NEVER able to create a cat eye look until now! I absolutely LOVE this eyeliner and will 100% repurchase when I run out. The eyeliner it self applies so smooth and consistent and lasts all day as well as comes off easily when needed.

reviews.t: I must say I am very pleased with it
reviews.x: I received this last night, I must say I am very pleased with it. The color is dark and stamps very well. It still takes some practice to get the look you want, but overall it is a great product! Will buy again!

reviews.t: I'm a beginner it looks great. With a little practice it will look perfect
reviews.x: I'm a beginner it looks great.  With a little practice it will look perfect.  I post pictures Facebook everyone said I look fab! I be sixty in 34 days.  So ladies give this a try.  Did not bother my skin.
this is a great product, had not caused any irritation in this contact lens wearer. love my wings. stays put. i use to start the main shape then use a thinner liquid felt tip to tighten the wings.
Works great but be warned! I took the cap off to use the stamp end and it took the stamp with it, causing the ink to launch out of the tube! I was able to fix it easily though so thats a plus.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the stamp makes winged/cat-eye eyeliner quick and easy, especially for those who struggle with wings.
Several reviewers say the product lasts all day or through long shifts, though some report it smudges or comes off within a few hours, especially with sweat or humidity.
Some reviewers note the stamp is light or requires practice and multiple tries to get placement right, often using it as a guideline to fill in.
Reviewers praise the felt/pen tip on the other end as fine and easy to use.
A few reviewers mention the wing stamp size or pointed tip not matching their preference.
